content.value: Software design affects privacy, accessibility, security, resource use, and opportunity. Identify stakeholders, gather requirements, and evaluate intended and unintended effects. Respect licenses and authorship. Test with varied users and devices, and document limitations so users can make informed choices.

The explicit status communicates meaning without requiring color perception. A responsible design review also asks what personal information is needed, who can access it, and whether the program disadvantages a group.
Practice: trace the example by hand, change one input, and explain how the result changes. Check an empty or boundary case when the preconditions allow it.
